Operations.Name: ConfigReset
Operations.Description:
Reset database to configuration defaults.

If `reboot` is true this job will reboot the system after its completed with a delay of 10
seconds.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Options controlling the configuration reset behavior.

Operations.Name: ConfigSave
Operations.Description:
Create a tar file of security-sensitive information. These options select which information
is included in the tar file:

`secretseed` bool: When true, include password secret seed.
`pool_keys` bool: IGNORED and DEPRECATED as it does not apply on SCALE systems.
`root_authorized_keys` bool: When true, include "/root/.ssh/authorized_keys" file for the root user.

If none of these options are set, the tar file is not generated and the database file is returned.

Arguments.Name: options
Arguments.Description: Options controlling what data to include in the configuration backup.

Operations.Name: ConfigUpload
Operations.Description: Accepts a configuration file via job pipe.

Models.Name: ConfigResetOptions
Models.Description: Options controlling the configuration reset behavior.

Fields.Name: Reboot
Fields.Description: Whether to reboot the system after resetting configuration.

Models.Name: ConfigSaveOptions
Models.Description: Options controlling what data to include in the configuration backup.

Fields.Name: PoolKeys
Fields.Description: Whether to include encryption keys for storage pools in the backup.

Fields.Name: RootAuthorizedKeys
Fields.Description: Whether to include root user's SSH authorized keys in the backup.

Fields.Name: Secretseed
Fields.Description: Whether to include the secret seed in the configuration backup.
